about: Photo look (house style for story and philosophy cards).

image.prompt: An old hourglass beside a small stack of coins on a dark desk, warm side light.

scenes.narration: In investing, time does more of the work than skill.

image.prompt: A 1940s boy's hand counting coins on a wooden table beside a newspaper's stock pages, nostalgic light, no face.
A long road stretching to the horizon through farmland, decades-old feel, golden hour.

scenes.narration: One of the world's most famous investors bought his first shares as a boy, and he simply never stopped.

image.prompt: A rising line drawn on graph paper curving sharply upward at the far right, pencil beside it, close up.

scenes.narration: Most of his fortune came after his sixtieth birthday. Not because he got smarter, but because he kept going.

image.prompt: A snowball rolling down a long snowy hill, growing larger, low winter sun.
A huge snowball at the bottom of a hill, spray of snow, dramatic light.

scenes.narration: That's compounding. For years the growth looks slow. Then it speeds up dramatically.

image.prompt: A tortoise on a stone path at sunrise, close up, warm light.

scenes.narration: So you don't need brilliant returns. Decent, steady results held for a very long time can beat short bursts of genius.

image.prompt: A calm person reading by a window in soft morning light, a cup of tea, peaceful, face turned away.

scenes.narration: Start early, and avoid interruptions. Ask yourself: what could push me to stop, and how will I stay consistent?
